title: Pillager Of Undying
description: This resource pack adds a new 3D model for the Totem of Undying — a pillager holding an axe.
body:
# | Resource pack adds model of totem of undying, replacing it with a Pillager holding an axe.🪓
![saa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bf7d33d25761c5bdeb54fedb5249521da10eb41_0.webp)

## ⚙️ Supports:
- 1.21.6 - 1.21.10 Version of Java Minecraft.
- Does NOT conflict with any resource packs(unless the pack related to the totem itself).
- Includes custom texture.
- In future updates will have it own sound(MB).



### 🎨 Installation guide:
- 1️⃣ Download the .zip resource pack 📥

- 2️⃣ Open Minecraft → Options ⚙️ → Resource Packs → Open Pack Folder 📂

- 3️⃣ Put the .zip file there (don’t unzip ❌)

- 4️⃣ Enable it in-game ✅ → Done ✔️
  
- Download Guide▶️:[coolverynicevideo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_MZ0_bIgRNg)

**I KNOW the guy supposed to hold a crossbow, but I'm not that skilled yet to make it😭😭😭. Anyway, I'll be updating this rp to the other versions like below 1.21.6, also mb add my discord or something for a contact.**
